author: PhazonPirate
quote: Honestly had such high expectations for this game, as a GTA fan and also a Zelda fan I had honestly hoped that there'd finally be something to rival OOT after all these years on meta critic and hype in general, I'm very disappointed with the bugs and "woke" features of the game as well as seeing all the bought 10/10 reviews, even as a GTA fan who's followed that games for a long time you'd have to be delusional to not admit most of these reviews weren't bought, very disappointed in Rockstar especially because I've enjoyed other titles from them like Rd and Rd2.
